title: 47 ## PROPERTY STOLEN AND RECOVERED A large number of cases were reported in the country in which property was stolen. In order to make a comprehensive assessment, statistics were collected under two heads viz (i) property stolen and recovered in different categories of offences involving property such as dacoity, robbery, house-breaking thefts etc. and (ii) by the nature of property stolen and recovered such as copper wire, cycles, cattle etc. The number of cases in which property was recovered do not necessarily correspond to the number of cases reported during the year as they include all the past cases in which property was stolen.
